info.name: Collabspace API v1
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for **Collabspace** (Laravel 13 · PHP 8.4 · Sanctum · Reverb · Laravel AI · DomPDF).

### Quickstart
1. Start server: `php artisan serve`
2. Run **02 - Authentication → Login** (default seeded admin: `admin@example.com` / `password`).
3. `bearer_token` and resource IDs (`project_id`, `task_id`, `conversation_id`, `meeting_id`, `report_id`, `ai_message_id`) are **captured automatically** by Postman test scripts!
4. Switch `locale` variable between `en` and `ar` to test localization.
